from.place: the compact-generator hypothesis in the Brown representability input: a triangulated category with arbitrary coproducts is compactly generated when a set of compact objects has coproduct a generator

title: Compactly generated triangulated category
statement: Let C be a triangulated category with arbitrary coproducts. It is compactly generated if there is a set-indexed family \{E_i\}_{i \in I} of compact objects [def-pc-compact-object] whose coproduct is a generator [def-pc-generators].

Its statement is the Stacks Project definition at Tag 09SQ and depends only on the existing triangulated-category, compact-object, and generator definitions. No project Lean declaration states it.
